points.K9: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
points.K12: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
points.K13: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
points.K14: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
points.K15: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
points.K16: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
points.K17: 电压等级与危险场所别混淆
points.K19: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
points.K20: 电流型：进出电流比一比
points.K21: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
points.K22: 两种漏电保护器的区别
points.K24: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
points.K25: 清除可燃物，砂轮转速要匹配
points.K26: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好

points.S3: 发现隐患：停用、挂牌、报修

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在实验楼大厅的问答台后，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands behind a quiz podium in a bright university lab building lobby and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 欢迎来到用电安全知识问答！
overlay: 用电安全知识问答

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 插头、闪电、盾牌、电钻四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a power plug, a lightning bolt, a shield and an electric drill. No people.
shots.narration: 从电的常识，到防护和电动工具。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着一根外皮开裂的电源线，准备插到潮湿台面边的插座上
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a power cord with cracked outer insulation and reaches toward a wall socket beside a wet bench top.
shots.narration: 阿杰急着插电，没注意电线外皮裂了。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 破皮电线和水滴图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power cord with cracked insulation next to a water drop, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 破皮电线碰上水，很容易触电。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，指了指旁边空白的问答板
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops the young male student and points to a blank quiz board on an easel nearby.
shots.narration: 小研拦下他：先来答几道用电题吧。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白问题卡，阿杰和小研站在两边
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank question card, with the young male student and the female graduate student on either side.
shots.narration: 答对了，才知道危险藏在哪里。

shots.section_title: 第一问：电是什么
shots.scene: 欣欣举起问题卡，卡上画着闪电问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card showing a lightning bolt icon and a question mark icon.
shots.narration: 第一问：电是什么，怎样工作？
overlay: 第一问：电是什么

shots.section_title: 第一问：电是什么
shots.scene: 发电站图标通过电线连到一盏灯，箭头在线上流动
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power station connected by wires to a glowing lamp, with small arrows moving along the wire. No people.
shots.narration: 电是能量从一处流向另一处。

shots.section_title: 第一问：电是什么
shots.scene: 发电站图标旁出现电源插座
shots.prompt_en: A power station icon next to a wall socket icon, linked by a line. No people.
shots.narration: 它需要电源，比如发电站来提供。

shots.section_title: 第一问：电是什么
shots.scene: 小圆点沿着导线绕成一个闭合的圈
shots.prompt_en: Small glowing dots travel along a wire that forms a closed loop around a battery and a bulb. No people.
shots.narration: 电子沿导体流动，走的是闭合回路。

shots.section_title: 电流与电路
shots.scene: 小研在白板上画出电池、导线和灯泡
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student draws a battery, wires and a light bulb on a blank whiteboard.
shots.narration: 先认识几个词：电流和电路。
overlay: 电流与电路

shots.section_title: 电流与电路
shots.scene: 导线中一串箭头整齐地向前移动，旁边有电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: A row of arrows moving forward inside a wire next to an ammeter icon with a needle. No people.
shots.narration: 电流是电荷的定向移动，单位是安培。

shots.section_title: 电流与电路
shots.scene: 电源、导线、灯泡连成一圈，灯亮起
shots.prompt_en: A power source, wires and a lamp connected in a full loop, and the lamp lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 电路是电流走的完整通路。

shots.section_title: 电流与电路
shots.scene: 一圈电路中依次亮起电源、导线、负载三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons light up one by one around a circuit loop: a battery, a wire and a heater. No people.
shots.narration: 它由电源、导线和用电负载组成。

shots.section_title: 电流与电路
shots.scene: 台灯、电钻、加热器三个负载图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a desk lamp, an electric drill and a small heater. No people.
shots.narration: 灯、工具、加热器，都是负载。

shots.section_title: 电阻与导体
shots.scene: 窄窄的管道里水流变慢，旁边是电阻图标
shots.prompt_en: A narrow pipe slowing down a water flow, next to a resistor symbol icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电阻，是对电流的阻碍。
overlay: 电阻与导体

shots.section_title: 电阻与导体
shots.scene: 金属线中电流顺畅通过，发出亮光
shots.prompt_en: Bright current flows smoothly through a shiny copper wire. No people.
shots.narration: 导体电阻很小，容易让电流通过。

shots.section_title: 电阻与导体
shots.scene: 铜线、铝条、钢钉三个金属图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a copper wire coil, an aluminum bar and a steel nail. No people.
shots.narration: 大多数金属都是导体。

shots.section_title: 接地与绝缘体
shots.scene: 设备金属外壳用一根绿黄线连到地下的接地符号
shots.prompt_en: The metal case of a lab instrument is connected by a green and yellow wire to a ground symbol below the floor. No people.
shots.narration: 接地，是把导电部分和大地连起来。
overlay: 接地与绝缘体

shots.section_title: 接地与绝缘体
shots.scene: 漏出的电流沿接地线流走，旁边的人形图标安然无恙
shots.prompt_en: Leaking current flows away through the green and yellow ground wire while a nearby person pictogram stays safe. No people.
shots.narration: 这是一道保护措施，帮人避免触电。

shots.section_title: 接地与绝缘体
shots.scene: 玻璃、陶瓷、塑料、干木四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a glass plate, a porcelain insulator, a plastic sheet and a piece of dry wood. No people.
shots.narration: 绝缘体电阻很高，比如玻璃和塑料。

shots.section_title: 接地与绝缘体
shots.scene: 电线外的塑料皮把电流包在里面
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of a power cord: bright current stays inside the copper core, wrapped by plastic insulation. No people.
shots.narration: 它把电挡在不该去的地方之外。

shots.section_title: 电气伤害分两类
shots.scene: 欣欣翻开第二张问题卡
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips to a second blank question card with a first aid cross icon.
shots.narration: 第二问：电会造成哪些伤害？
overlay: 电气伤害分两类

shots.section_title: 电气伤害分两类
shots.scene: 两个方框：左边闪电击中人形，右边人形从梯子上跌落
shots.prompt_en: Two boxes side by side: on the left a lightning bolt hits a person pictogram, on the right a person pictogram falls from a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 分两类：直接伤害和间接伤害。

shots.section_title: 电气伤害分两类
shots.scene: 闪电、心电图直线、烧伤图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a flat heart monitor line and a burn mark on a hand. No people.
shots.narration: 直接伤害有电击、烧伤，甚至死亡。

shots.section_title: 电气伤害分两类
shots.scene: 人形站在梯子上碰到电线，惊得松手
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram on a ladder touches a wire, jerks back and lets go of the ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 间接伤害：被电一下，从高处摔下。

shots.section_title: 电气伤害分两类
shots.scene: 老李在梯子上作业，系着安全带，下面有人扶梯
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer works on a ladder wearing a safety harness while the young male student steadies the ladder.
shots.narration: 登高附近用电，更要防坠落。

shots.section_title: 电击轻重看三点
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第三张问题卡，卡上是一个温度计式的刻度
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a third blank question card with a severity gauge icon.
shots.narration: 第三问：电击轻重看什么？
overlay: 电击轻重看三点

shots.section_title: 电击轻重看三点
shots.scene: 人体轮廓上画出一条电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body outline with an arrow showing a current path from one hand into the body. No people.
shots.narration: 一看路径：电流从哪里进、哪里出。

shots.section_title: 电击轻重看三点
shots.scene: 粗细不同的三条电流箭头
shots.prompt_en: Three current arrows of increasing thickness side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 二看大小：流过身体的电流越大越重。

shots.section_title: 电击轻重看三点
shots.scene: 秒表图标旁边的电流箭头越拉越长
shots.prompt_en: A stopwatch icon next to a current arrow that grows longer and longer. No people.
shots.narration: 三看时间：通电时间越长越危险。

shots.section_title: 低电压不等于低危险
shots.scene: 普通墙壁插座上叠加黄色警告三角
shots.prompt_en: An ordinary wall socket with a yellow electrical warning triangle sign beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 记住：低电压不等于低危险。
overlay: 低电压不等于低危险

shots.section_title: 低电压不等于低危险
shots.scene: 欣欣严肃地指着实验室插座
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points seriously at a power socket on a lab wall.
shots.narration: 家用和实验室的电源，都可能致命。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第四张问题卡，卡上画着心形
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a fourth blank question card with a heart icon.
shots.narration: 第四问：电走哪条路最危险？
overlay: 经过心脏的路径最危险

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 人体轮廓，心脏处闪着红光
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with the heart area glowing red. No people.
shots.narration: 电流经过心脏，危险最大。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 人体轮廓上箭头从左手穿过胸口到右手
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a red arrow from the left hand across the chest to the right hand. No people.
shots.narration: 第一种：从手到手。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 箭头从手经胸口到脚
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a red arrow from one hand down through the chest to the opposite foot. No people.
shots.narration: 第二种：从手到脚。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 箭头从头顶经胸口到脚
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a red arrow from the top of the head down through the chest to the feet. No people.
shots.narration: 第三种：从头到脚。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 箭头从一只脚到另一只脚，颜色较浅
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline with a pale orange arrow from one foot to the other foot, not passing the chest. No people.
shots.narration: 不经过心脏的路径，相对轻一些。

shots.section_title: 经过心脏的路径最危险
shots.scene: 欣欣摆手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves a paw in a cautionary gesture.
shots.narration: 但任何触电，都不能心存侥幸。

shots.section_title: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第五张问题卡，卡上画着肌肉图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a fifth blank question card with a flexed arm muscle icon.
shots.narration: 第五问：电击为什么这么危险？
overlay: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用

shots.section_title: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
shots.scene: 手握电线的人形图标，手部肌肉发紧松不开
shots.prompt_en: A pictogram of a hand gripping a wire, the hand muscles tense and unable to let go, with zigzag lines. No people.
shots.narration: 电流稍大，肌肉就会麻痹、僵住。

shots.section_title: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
shots.scene: 手抓电线图标旁边出现打叉的松手箭头
shots.prompt_en: A hand gripping a wire icon next to a crossed out release arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 手被吸住，自己根本摆脱不了。

shots.section_title: 电流对肌肉和心脏的作用
shots.scene: 心电图曲线变得又快又乱
shots.prompt_en: A heart monitor line that turns fast and chaotic, next to a heart icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电流再大，心脏会乱跳、泵不出血。

shots.section_title: 心脏骤停要尽快除颤
shots.scene: AED 除颤器箱子挂在墙上
shots.prompt_en: An automated external defibrillator cabinet with a heart and lightning icon mounted on a hallway wall. No people.
shots.narration: 心脏骤停，几分钟内就会致命。
overlay: 心脏骤停要尽快除颤

shots.section_title: 心脏骤停要尽快除颤
shots.scene: AED 打开，两块电极片图标贴在人体轮廓胸口
shots.prompt_en: An open defibrillator with two pads placed on the chest of a simple human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 及时用上除颤器，能大大提高生存机会。

shots.section_title: 危害：线路、外露、绝缘
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第六张问题卡，卡上画着闪电警告
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a sixth blank question card with an electrical warning triangle.
shots.narration: 第六问：用电有哪些危害？
overlay: 危害：线路、外露、绝缘

shots.section_title: 危害：线路、外露、绝缘
shots.scene: 墙上乱拉的电线和临时接头
shots.prompt_en: A messy tangle of improvised wires and taped joints running along a lab wall. No people.
shots.narration: 线路不合格、乱拉乱接，是隐患。

shots.section_title: 危害：线路、外露、绝缘
shots.scene: 配电箱面板缺了盖，露出铜排
shots.prompt_en: An electrical panel with a missing cover exposing bare copper bars, with a yellow warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部件外露，伸手就可能碰到。

shots.section_title: 危害：线路、外露、绝缘
shots.scene: 电线外皮破损，露出铜芯
shots.prompt_en: Close view of a power cord with damaged insulation showing bare copper strands. No people.
shots.narration: 电线绝缘破了，同样危险。

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 插头接地脚被掰掉的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a plug with its ground pin broken off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 设备和工具没接地，外壳可能带电。
overlay: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 一个插座上插满插头，电线发热冒烟
shots.prompt_en: One wall socket overloaded with many plugs, the wires glowing hot with a wisp of smoke. No people.
shots.narration: 电路过载，线会发热，甚至起火。

shots.section_title: 危害：未接地、过载、坏工具
shots.scene: 外壳开裂的电钻放在台面上
shots.prompt_en: An electric drill with a cracked housing and frayed cord lying on a workbench, with a red warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 损坏的电动工具和设备，不能再用。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 普通布手套和金属起子打叉，绝缘手套和绝缘工具打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icons: a cloth glove and a plain metal screwdriver crossed out in red, insulated gloves and an insulated screwdriver with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 用错防护用品和工具，也会触电。
overlay: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 户外架空电线下，一根长杆图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Outdoor overhead power lines with a long metal pole icon raised toward them, crossed out in red. No people.
shots.narration: 户外有架空电线，长杆长梯要远离。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 水滴图标放大在所有危害图标上方
shots.prompt_en: A big water drop icon hovers above a row of electrical hazard icons, making them glow brighter. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿环境，会让所有危害加重。

shots.section_title: 危害：用错防护、架空线、潮湿
shots.scene: 烧伤、闪电、火焰、电弧四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a burned hand, a lightning bolt, a flame with an explosion burst, and a bright electric arc. No people.
shots.narration: 后果是烧伤、电击、火灾爆炸和电弧。

shots.section_title: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
shots.scene: 欣欣翻到问题卡背面，画着盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips the question card to show a shield icon on the back.
shots.narration: 那么，怎么防护？
overlay: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器

shots.section_title: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
shots.scene: 老李检查设备接地线是否牢固
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks that the green and yellow ground wire of a lab instrument is firmly connected.
shots.narration: 第一，接地要可靠。

shots.section_title: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
shots.scene: 配电箱里一个带试验按钮的漏电保护器
shots.prompt_en: A residual current circuit breaker with a test button installed in an open distribution box. No people.
shots.narration: 第二，装好漏电保护器。

shots.section_title: 防护：接地、漏电保护、熔断器
shots.scene: 熔断器和空气开关图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cartridge fuse and a miniature circuit breaker side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 第三，用好熔断器和断路器，防过载。

shots.section_title: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 带电端子外加透明防护罩
shots.prompt_en: Live terminals in a cabinet covered by a clear protective shield, with an electrical warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 带电部件要加罩、加挡。
overlay: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌

shots.section_title: 防护：遮挡带电部件、上锁挂牌
shots.scene: 老李给断开的电闸挂上锁和空白挂牌
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer puts a padlock and a blank tag on a switched off circuit breaker handle.
shots.narration: 检修前断电，上锁挂牌，防止误送电。

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 电线整齐沿墙走，不压在椅子轮下
shots.prompt_en: A flexible power cord routed neatly along the wall, a chair wheel rolling over a cord shown in an icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 软电线不拖拽、不碾压、不打死结。
overlay: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 配电箱门关好，旁边有触电警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A closed electrical distribution box door with an electrical hazard warning sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 配电箱门要关好，无关人员别碰。

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 地面积水处的插线板打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a power strip lying in a puddle on the floor, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 避免在潮湿的地方用电作业。

shots.section_title: 防护：软线、关柜门、避潮湿、培训
shots.scene: 王老师给学生做用电安全培训
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator gives an electrical safety training session to a small group of students in front of a blank screen.
shots.narration: 用电作业的人，必须先经过培训。

shots.section_title: 电压等级与危险场所别混淆
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第七张问题卡，卡上画着高低不同的电塔
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a seventh blank question card with tall and short power pylon icons.
shots.narration: 第七问：电压等级怎么分？
overlay: 电压等级与危险场所别混淆

shots.section_title: 电压等级与危险场所别混淆
shots.scene: 高、中、低三个台阶，每阶一个闪电
shots.prompt_en: Three steps of different heights, each with a lightning bolt icon of different size. No people.
shots.narration: 电压按高低分等级，越高越要专业管理。

shots.section_title: 电压等级与危险场所别混淆
shots.scene: 小研对比两张卡片：一张电塔，一张气体火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares two blank cards, one with a power pylon icon and one with a gas cloud and flame icon.
shots.narration: 有可燃气体的场所，另按防爆要求划分。

shots.section_title: 电压等级与危险场所别混淆
shots.scene: 王老师举起空白的国家标准文本
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds up a blank standards booklet.
shots.narration: 两者别混用，具体以现行标准为准。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第八张问题卡，卡上是漏电保护器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an eighth blank question card with a circuit breaker icon.
shots.narration: 第八问：漏电保护器有几种？
overlay: 两种漏电保护器

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器
shots.scene: 两个漏电断路器图标，一个旧的灰色，一个新的白色
shots.prompt_en: Two circuit breaker icons side by side, an old gray one and a newer white one with a test button. No people.
shots.narration: 老式的看电压，新式的看电流。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器
shots.scene: 旧的灰色图标慢慢淡出
shots.prompt_en: The old gray circuit breaker icon slowly fades out while the newer white one stays bright. No people.
shots.narration: 如今电流型基本取代了电压型。

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 简化电路：仪器金属外壳一根线连到检测块，再到大地
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: the metal case of an instrument connected by a green and yellow wire to a sensing block and then to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第九问：电压型怎么动作？
overlay: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 相线碰到外壳，外壳闪红光
shots.prompt_en: In the diagram, a live wire touches the metal case and the case flashes red. No people.
shots.narration: 相线碰壳，漏电流从接地线流走。

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 检测块亮起，开关弹开
shots.prompt_en: In the diagram, the sensing block lights up and the breaker contacts snap open. No people.
shots.narration: 检测到电压，就跳闸断开电源。

shots.section_title: 电压型漏电保护器怎样动作
shots.scene: 接地线断开图标，检测块灰暗
shots.prompt_en: In the diagram, the ground wire is broken and the sensing block stays dark, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 可接地线一断，它就不灵了。

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第十张问题卡，卡上是一个圆环
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a tenth blank question card with a ring shaped current transformer icon.
shots.narration: 第十问：电流型怎样工作？
overlay: 电流型：进出电流比一比

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 两根导线穿过一个圆环，箭头一去一回
shots.prompt_en: Two wires pass through a ring shaped sensor, one arrow going out and one arrow coming back. No people.
shots.narration: 相线和中性线一起穿过检测线圈。

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 天平两边一样重，平稳不动
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with equal weights on both sides, perfectly level. No people.
shots.narration: 流出多少、流回多少，时刻在比较。

shots.section_title: 电流型：进出电流比一比
shots.scene: 圆环旁出现零的图标，开关保持闭合
shots.prompt_en: The ring sensor shows a zero icon and the breaker contacts stay closed, a lamp keeps glowing. No people.
shots.narration: 正常时两边相等，差值为零，不动作。

shots.section_title: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
shots.scene: 人形图标手碰相线，一小股电流经人体流入地面
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram touches a live wire and a small arrow of current flows through the pictogram into the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 有人碰到相线，一部分电流经人体入地。
overlay: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸

shots.section_title: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
shots.scene: 天平一边高一边低
shots.prompt_en: The balance scale tips to one side. No people.
shots.narration: 流回的电流少了，两边不再相等。

shots.section_title: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
shots.scene: 圆环检测到差值，发出信号到脱扣线圈
shots.prompt_en: The ring sensor glows and sends a signal to a trip coil icon. No people.
shots.narration: 线圈检测到差值，立刻驱动脱扣。

shots.section_title: 电流型：有人触电就跳闸
shots.scene: 开关弹开，灯熄灭，人形图标安全
shots.prompt_en: The breaker contacts snap open, the lamp goes dark, and the person pictogram is safe. No people.
shots.narration: 开关跳闸，把故障电路断开。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第十一张问题卡，两种图标左右对比
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up an eleventh blank question card with two breaker icons compared side by side.
shots.narration: 第十一问：两种有什么区别？
overlay: 两种漏电保护器的区别

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 左边电压表图标，右边电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: A voltmeter icon on the left and an ammeter icon on the right, separated by a line. No people.
shots.narration: 一个靠检测电压，一个靠检测电流。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 左边图标连着接地线，接地线断开时打问号
shots.prompt_en: On the left, a breaker icon depends on a ground wire; when the wire is broken a question mark appears. No people.
shots.narration: 电压型离不开良好接地。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 左边图标：漏电走别的路时不动作
shots.prompt_en: On the left, leakage current takes another path around the ground wire and the breaker stays closed, with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电不走接地线，它就不动作。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 右边图标：不论电流从哪里漏走都跳闸
shots.prompt_en: On the right, leakage current escapes by any path and the breaker trips open, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 电流型不靠接地线，漏电都能发现。

shots.section_title: 两种漏电保护器的区别
shots.scene: 小研在空白笔记本上画勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks a box in a blank notebook.
shots.narration: 所以现在普遍使用电流型。

shots.section_title: 电动工具有哪些危害
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第十二张问题卡，卡上画着电钻
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a twelfth blank question card with an electric drill icon.
shots.narration: 第十二问：电动工具有啥危害？
overlay: 电动工具有哪些危害

shots.section_title: 电动工具有哪些危害
shots.scene: 闪电、火焰、火花三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a lightning bolt, a flame with an explosion burst and flying sparks. No people.
shots.narration: 电击、火灾爆炸，还有飞溅的火花。

shots.section_title: 电动工具有哪些危害
shots.scene: 割伤、烫伤、耳朵声波、手部振动四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cut finger, a burned hand, an ear with sound waves and a hand with vibration lines. No people.
shots.narration: 割伤、烫伤、噪声和振动也要防。

shots.section_title: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
shots.scene: 欣欣举起第十三张问题卡，卡上画着打勾的电钻
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a thirteenth blank question card with an electric drill icon and a green check.
shots.narration: 最后一问：怎样安全用工具？
overlay: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩

shots.section_title: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
shots.scene: 工具插在带漏电保护器的电源上
shots.prompt_en: An electric angle grinder plugged into a power box fitted with a residual current circuit breaker. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定的电压供电，配漏电保护。

shots.section_title: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
shots.scene: 手松开开关，工具立刻停转
shots.prompt_en: A hand releases the trigger of an electric drill and the drill bit stops spinning immediately. No people.
shots.narration: 工具要有松手即停的开关。

shots.section_title: 电动工具：漏保、松手即停、防护罩
shots.scene: 角磨机防护罩完好的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close view of an angle grinder with its wheel guard firmly in place, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 机械防护罩要完好，不能拆。

shots.section_title: 清除可燃物，砂轮转速要匹配
shots.scene: 阿杰把纸箱和酒精瓶搬离工作台
shots.prompt_en: The young male student carries cardboard boxes and a closed solvent bottle away from a workbench before using a grinder.
shots.narration: 作业区先清走可燃、易燃物品。
overlay: 清除可燃物，砂轮转速要匹配

shots.section_title: 清除可燃物，砂轮转速要匹配
shots.scene: 砂轮片和机器两个转速表，砂轮那边指针更高
shots.prompt_en: Two dial icons: the dial for the grinding wheel shows a higher reading than the dial for the machine, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 砂轮的额定转速，必须高于机器转速。

shots.section_title: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好
shots.scene: 火花被防火挡板完全挡住
shots.prompt_en: Sparks from a grinder hit a fire resistant screen and are fully contained behind it. No people.
shots.narration: 火花要全部挡住，不能飞出去。
overlay: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好

shots.section_title: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好
shots.scene: 隔离的焊接操作间和防火帘
shots.prompt_en: A separate welding booth with fire resistant curtains in a workshop. No people.
shots.narration: 焊接放进专门隔开的操作间。

shots.section_title: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好
shots.scene: 灭火器、灭火毯，老李在一旁看守
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher and a folded fire blanket beside a work area while the facility engineer stands watch.
shots.narration: 备好灭火器、灭火毯，安排专人看火。

shots.section_title: 火花要挡住，灭火器材要备好
shots.scene: 王老师在空白审批单上签字
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator signs a blank work permit form at a desk.
shots.narration: 校内动火，按学校规定先审批。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与轮换
shots.scene: 阿杰戴护目镜再加面罩
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts on safety goggles and then a full face shield in a workshop.
shots.narration: 眼睛双重防护：护目镜加面罩。
overlay: 个人防护与轮换

shots.section_title: 个人防护与轮换
shots.scene: 皮手套和皮围裙
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wears leather gloves and a leather apron.
shots.narration: 戴皮手套、穿围裙，防烫防割。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与轮换
shots.scene: 耳塞和耳罩图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of foam ear plugs and ear muffs side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 噪声大，要戴耳塞或耳罩。

shots.section_title: 个人防护与轮换
shots.scene: 两名学生交换位置，时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student hands over the tool to the female graduate student, a clock icon floats above them.
shots.narration: 长时间作业，要轮换休息。

shots.section_title: 选用合格电器，带接地插头
shots.scene: 欣欣拿起一个带接地脚的三孔插头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a three pin plug with a ground pin.
shots.narration: 加分题：实验室选什么样的电器？
overlay: 选用合格电器，带接地插头

shots.section_title: 选用合格电器，带接地插头
shots.scene: 合格证书图标和带接地插头的仪器
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument with a three pin grounded plug next to a blank certificate icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 选用符合国家标准的合格电器。

shots.section_title: 选用合格电器，带接地插头
shots.scene: 三孔插头被剪掉接地脚的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of scissors cutting off the ground pin of a plug, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 金属外壳设备，接地脚不能去掉。

shots.section_title: 插线板不串接、不超载
shots.scene: 插线板串插线板的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one power strip plugged into another power strip in a chain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板不串接，不私拉乱接。
overlay: 插线板不串接、不超载

shots.section_title: 插线板不串接、不超载
shots.scene: 大功率加热设备接在墙上专用插座
shots.prompt_en: A high power drying oven plugged directly into its own dedicated wall socket. No people.
shots.narration: 大功率设备用专用插座。

shots.section_title: 插线板不串接、不超载
shots.scene: 插线板放在干燥台面上，没有压在杂物下
shots.prompt_en: A power strip placed on a dry shelf in the open, not covered by papers or boxes. No people.
shots.narration: 插线板放干燥处，别被杂物盖住。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患：停用、挂牌、报修
shots.scene: 阿杰闻到焦味，发现插头发黑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student notices a scorched plug and a faint burning smell icon near a socket.
shots.narration: 插头发烫、发黑、有焦味？
overlay: 发现隐患：停用、挂牌、报修

shots.section_title: 发现隐患：停用、挂牌、报修
shots.scene: 阿杰关掉开关，在设备上挂空白停用牌
shots.prompt_en: The young male student switches off the equipment and hangs a blank out of service tag on it.
shots.narration: 先断电停用，挂上停用牌。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患：停用、挂牌、报修
shots.scene: 阿杰打电话，老李提着工具箱赶来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student makes a phone call while the facility engineer arrives carrying a toolbox.
shots.narration: 报告实验室负责人，请持证电工维修。

shots.section_title: 发现隐患：停用、挂牌、报修
shots.scene: 学生拿螺丝刀拆插座的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student opening a wall socket with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不要自己拆修电气线路。

shots.section_title: 湿手和液体远离电
shots.scene: 湿手按开关的图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wet hand dripping water reaching for a light switch, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 湿手不碰开关和插头。
overlay: 湿手和液体远离电

shots.section_title: 湿手和液体远离电
shots.scene: 小研把水杯和洗瓶移到远离插线板的地方
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves a wash bottle and a beaker of water away from a power strip on the bench.
shots.narration: 盛水容器远离插座和电器。

shots.section_title: 湿手和液体远离电
shots.scene: 地上有水，阿杰先放置警示牌并擦干
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places a wet floor warning stand and mops up water near a socket before working.
shots.narration: 地面有水，先擦干再用电。

shots.section_title: 实验接线：先断电，查过再通电
shots.scene: 阿杰在电工实验台前准备接线，台上电源开关处于断开位置
shots.prompt_en: The young male student prepares to connect wires on an electrical training bench; the bench power switch is in the off position.
shots.narration: 做电路实验，先断电，再接线。
overlay: 实验接线：先断电，查过再通电

shots.section_title: 实验接线：先断电，查过再通电
shots.scene: 给通着电的电路板插拔导线的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand plugging a test lead into a powered circuit board with a lightning symbol, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 通着电改接线，绝对不行。

shots.section_title: 实验接线：先断电，查过再通电
shots.scene: 阿杰对照空白电路图逐根核对导线
shots.prompt_en: The young male student checks each test lead one by one against a blank circuit diagram.
shots.narration: 接完对照电路图，逐根查一遍。

shots.section_title: 实验接线：先断电，查过再通电
shots.scene: 老周检查接线后点头，阿杰合上电源
shots.prompt_en: The older man inspects the wiring and nods; then the young male student switches the bench power on.
shots.narration: 老师检查同意后，再合电源。

shots.section_title: 实验接线：先断电，查过再通电
shots.scene: 冒烟和焦味图标旁，一只手按下电源开关
shots.prompt_en: Icons of smoke and a burning smell next to a hand pressing the bench power switch off. No people.
shots.narration: 有异味、冒烟，立即断电报告。

shots.section_title: 实验接线：先断电，查过再通电
shots.scene: 实验结束，阿杰先关电源，再拆下导线收好
shots.prompt_en: After the experiment, the young male student switches the power off first, then removes the test leads and coils them neatly.
shots.narration: 做完先断电，再拆线收好。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 欣欣站在问答板前，板上排着电流、心脏、盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a quiz board showing icons of a current arrow, a heart and a shield.
shots.narration: 电流过心最危险，低压也不能大意。
overlay: 小结

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 破线、过载、潮湿三个图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons crossed out in red: a damaged cord, an overloaded socket and a water drop on a plug. No people.
shots.narration: 破线、过载、潮湿，都是隐患。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 接地线、漏电保护器、锁和挂牌三个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a ground wire symbol, a residual current breaker and a padlock with a tag. No people.
shots.narration: 接地、漏保、上锁挂牌，层层防护。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 防护罩、灭火器、护目镜图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a grinder guard, a fire extinguisher and safety goggles. No people.
shots.narration: 用工具：有防护、清可燃、戴装备。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 断开的电源开关和打勾的空白电路图
